sources: Codex audit 2026-05-04 — QA exists as process, not as structured criteria per shot type
_meta.principle: QA rubrics are STRUCTURED CRITERIA per shot type. The council's jury-video skill currently uses one generic rubric; this file slices it by shot intent so jurors can score what actually matters for THAT shot.
consumed_by: tools/lib/auto-jury.mjs — pick rubric by shot type (Phase 2.11h+)

product._use: Product hero shots — knife, mug, gadget on a surface

dimensions.product_scale_fidelity: Does the product look the size it should be? Score 1-10.
dimensions.material_truth: Steel reads as steel, copper as copper, fabric as fabric — no plastic-look slip.
dimensions.shadow_physics: Cast shadow direction + softness consistent with declared light source.
dimensions.edge_anatomy: No warped edges, melted handles, extra screws, missing details.
dimensions.product_centerline: Composition obeys the rule used in storyboard (rule of thirds / centered / off-center).

human._use: Talking-head, founder shots, lifestyle with a person

dimensions.anatomy: Two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand, no extra limbs, no melted face.
dimensions.skin_realism: Pores visible, no plastic skin, no over-smoothed AI-doll look.
dimensions.eye_continuity: Eyes track natural attention, no dead-doll stare, no mismatched gaze.
dimensions.lipsync: If VO present — does mouth shape match phonemes? Off by ≤2 frames acceptable.
dimensions.expression_naturalness: Smile / frown / focus reads as genuine, not rictus.

ugc._use: Native social ads — phone-shot feel, founder selfie energy

dimensions.authenticity: Reads as real phone footage, not stock-shoot polish. NO premium lighting, NO bokeh on talking head.
dimensions.imperfection_calibration: Slight handheld jitter present but not seasick. Slight focus hunt acceptable.
dimensions.framing_native: Phone-natural framing — head not perfectly centered, slight Dutch tilt OK.
dimensions.lighting_practical: Visible practical light source (window, screen, lamp) — not a studio key.
dimensions.captions_legibility: If captions burned — readable on mobile at 12% brightness.

ugc.note: UGC inverts premium rubric. Polished AI ads convert 4× WORSE on social per 2026 neuroscience.

dimensions.ui_legibility: Text on screen is readable (or correctly blurred if intentional). No garbled glyphs.
dimensions.interaction_logic: Tap → response, swipe → motion. Action reads as causal.
dimensions.screen_glow_realism: Screen casts believable light onto subject's face — no over-saturated glow.
dimensions.task_completion_clarity: Viewer can name the action that just happened in the shot.

lipsync._use: Any shot where VO is delivered to camera — wake-word activation, founder direct-address

dimensions.phoneme_match: Mouth shape matches the spoken phoneme on the right frame, ±2 frames.
dimensions.syllable_count: Visible mouth-open events match audible syllable count.
dimensions.consonant_anchors: Hard consonants (P, B, M closed mouth; F, V lower lip; T, D tongue) hit visibly on the audio frame.
dimensions.wake_word_anchor: If wake word present — mouth-open frame aligns to start_s of the VO layer.

lipsync.tooling: Probe sample frames at 1fps to find mouth-open moments BEFORE scheduling VO start_s in the audio mix manifest.

typography._use: Kinetic-type Reels, copy-led posts, no-photo shots

dimensions.font_brand_match: Font matches the brand's locked typography stack — no substitutions.
dimensions.kerning: Letter spacing reads tight and intentional, not loose stock-text.
dimensions.rhythm: Word reveals land on audio beats; key word lands on the punchline beat.
dimensions.color_brand_match: Color = brand accent only, no off-palette decisions.

typography.note: Typography QA is strict — typography errors are the cheapest fix and the most damaging brand signal.

dimensions.intent_fidelity: Final cut delivers the campaign's stated intent (hook → problem → solution → CTA).
dimensions.continuity: Identity / scale / lighting / color hold across all shots.
dimensions.pacing: Cuts land on audio beats. No shot lingers after its job is done.
dimensions.audio_layering: VO ≥10 dB above music. SFX hit on visual beat. Loudnorm I=-16 LUFS.
dimensions.cta_clarity: Final beat tells the viewer what to do (URL, action, step).

final_cut.ship_threshold: median ≥ 7 across dimensions; NO dimension below 5

rules.dual_juror_required: Visual QA always runs Opus AND Sonnet in parallel. Divergence is the signal — Sonnet catches what Opus misses (2026-05-03 saved a shipping blocker).
rules.frame_extraction: ffmpeg keyframe extract at ≥1 fps for both jurors against an identical frame set. See visual_qa_recipe.md.
rules.blockers_block: Any DON'T-SHIP from any juror = pipeline halt. SHIP-WITH-FIXES = list of edits, no ship until cleared.
rules.rubric_pick_strategy: Composer or skill picks rubric by shot.intent or campaign.shot_type. Mixed campaigns score each shot against its OWN rubric, then run final_cut against the whole.
